programme.title: La Pop Star
programme.desc: Carly et ses amis tentent d'aider une ancienne pop star à réaliser la vidéo de son grand retour.

programme.title: Freddy, mon héros
programme.desc: Freddy sauve Carly qui était sur le point de se faire percuter par un camion. Elle tombe alors amoureuse de lui.

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: Gibby perd son sang froid
programme.desc: Gibby est persuadé que Freddie est intéressé par sa nouvelle petite amie. Il lui propose alors de le défier au cours d'un combat, que Sam décide de diffuser en direct dans l'émission de Carly.

programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Le concours de beauté
programme.desc: Sam révèle à Carly et Freddie avoir participé à un concours de beauté lorsqu'elle était plus jeune.

programme.title: Le rendez-vous de Spencer
programme.desc: Sam se retrouve accidentellement en prison et Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour que l'émission ait lieu malgré tout. Ils demandent alors l'aide de Spencer, qui a malheureusement un rendez-vous ce soir là.

programme.title: dans lespace
programme.desc: iCarly se voit proposer de tourner un web show exceptionnel dans l'Espace grâce à un milliardaire qui souhaite promouvoir un nouveau concept de voyage spatial...

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: A la suite d'un reportage aux infos, Carly est bien décidée à prouver à tout le monde que BIGFOOT, un primate humanoïde, existe réellement.

programme.title: Freddie déménage!
programme.desc: Freddie ne supporte plus que ça mère le traite comme un bébé et déménage. Carly et Sam monte une affaire de photographie animalière, mais sont vite dérangées par d'autres photographes ne supportant pas la concurrence.

programme.title: Vague de chaleur
programme.desc: A cause de la vague de chaleur, la ville subit une panne de courant. Spencer, toujours plein da ressource, met en marche un générateur électrique et un climatiseur ultra performant.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Miranda, l'actrice qui joue le rôle d'iCarly convoque Jerry, le comédien jouant Spencer sur le plateau pour lui remonter les bretelles.

programme.title: Halloween Island
programme.desc: Kai, Leilani et Eddie, trois enfants que tout oppose, doivent mettre de côté leurs différences pour sauver Hawaï d'un terrible démon légendaire qu'ils ont réveillé par erreur. Face aux plus grands dangers, les enfants vont comprendre ce que sont le courage, l'amitié et les traditions.

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E39 A un poil près ! - Corneil doit aller chez Vangus, son toiletteur attitré. Bernie aimerait plutôt l'emmener chez sa tante Gina qui vient juste d'ouvrir un salon. Découvrant que Gina est une piètre coiffeuse, Corneil ne veut rien savoir.

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.sub-title: S1:E40 Quand la malchance vous sourit
programme.desc: S1:E40 Quand la malchance vous sourit - Bernie a trouvé une montre de valeur. Pour lui, trouver c'est garder ! Mais Corneil s'y oppose farouchement. Pour lui, garder cette montre c'est du vol. Comment forcer Bernie à la rapporter aux objets trouvés ? Tout simplement en lui faisant croire que la montre porte malheur !

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.sub-title: S1:E41 Coup de foudre au lycée
programme.desc: S1:E41 Coup de foudre au lycée - Une nouvelle fois, Bernie a des problèmes au lycée. Mme Martin, la principale, a décidé de le renvoyer. Corneil, pour venir en aide à son dogsitter, fait en sorte qu'Oncle Rico et Mme Martin se lient d'amitié. Et si le coup de foudre était aussi au rendez-vous ?

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E42 Le club des poètes - Corneil rêve de rejoindre le club de poésie de Marta. Pour cela, il supplie Bernie de s'y inscrire à sa place. Grâce au savoir de Corneil, Bernie devient membre de ce club très fermé. Si Corneil est aux anges, Bernie réalise que le club est loin de répondre à ses rêves !

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S3:E9 The Ni Ni Tree - True et Bartleby doivent traverser la forêt de nuit pour aider les Yétis à trouver davantage de lumières Ni Ni.

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S3:E10 Scratch and Share - Il y a des Yétis Rouges et des Yétis Bleus… et les deux veulent le Bâton Spécial à Gratter ! Leur désaccord perturbe l'équilibre de la forêt. True pourra-t-elle les convaincre de coopérer et de partager ?

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S1:E1 Big Mossy Mess - Quand Bartleby rapporte chez lui un peu de mousse spéciale Zazoony, elle se met soudain à pousser de façon incontrôlable ! C'est maintenant à True d'arrêter sa propagation avant que la mousse ne recouvre tout le Royaume Arc-en-ciel.

programme.title: Les Schtroumpfs
programme.sub-title: S1:E76 Le Schtroumpf à Mémoire | Le Casse-Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: S1:E76 Le Schtroumpf à Mémoire | Le Casse-Schtroumpfs - Á la suite d'un accident lors d'une expérience, le Schtroumpf Maladroit est soudain doté d'une mémoire phénoménale. | Le Schtroumpf à Lunettes, après l'incendie qui a ravagé sa maison, est hébergé chez d'autres Schtroumpfs.

programme.title: Les Schtroumpfs
programme.sub-title: S1:E77 L'ami de Grossbouf | Le Schtroumpf à Lunettes Aime les Animaux
programme.desc: S1:E77 L'ami de Grossbouf | Le Schtroumpf à Lunettes Aime les Animaux - Gargamel et Balthazar commandent un automate géant afin de forcer le roi Gérard à leur remettre le Schtroumpf Robot. | Le Schtroumpf à Lunettes met son chapeau de safari et parcourt la forêt pour faire de bonnes actions pour les animaux.

programme.title: Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: S1:E1 La Schtroumpfette - Cette fois, le vilain sorcier Gargamel en est certain, il a découvert un moyen infaillible de se venger des Schtroumpfs. Il crée une Schtroumpfette, dont le charme agira sur les petits êtres bleus… Toutefois, le plan diabolique de Gargamel ne se déroule pas comme prévu, et il en est victime.

programme.title: Blue, mon chien d'Australie
programme.desc: Une histoire australienne emblématique de la famille, de l'amitié et de l'aventure, entre un jeune garçon et un chien rustique unique en son genre qui deviendra une légende australienne.

programme.title: Escobank
programme.desc: Un groupe de vétérans et d'anciens détenus explorent la jungle colombienne pour y retrouver les barils d'argent enterrés laissés par le légendaire baron de la drogue Pablo Escobar. Mais dans cette chasse au cash, le vrai danger n'est pas seulement la jungle...

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Une bande d'anciens soldats d'élite se reforme quand la famille de l'un d'entre eux est la cible d'une attaque.

programme.title: Déchainés
programme.desc: Alors que les célèbres criminels Gary Tison et Randy Greenwalt s'évadent de prison, leur cavale se transforme rapidement en une sanglante chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: The Cash Collector
programme.desc: Avec son partenaire Sue, French poursuit les débiteurs de son patron. Mais lorsqu'une de ses missions l'amène à poursuivre le patron d'un bar irlandais avec un secret, se pose la question de savoir si pour une fois, French fera ce qui est juste…

programme.title: Noryang : L'Affrontement Final
programme.desc: En 1598, la guerre d'Imjin, qui a duré sept ans, touche à sa fin et les envahisseurs japonais tentent une dernière offensive sur Joseon. L'amiral Yi Sun-shin prend la tête d'une armada marine avec la Chine des Ming, dans le but d'en finir avec l'impérialisme japonais. Les forces en présence s'affrontent dans le détroit de Noryang, là où la mer est la plus meurtrière et où l'amiral Yi va livrer son ultime bataille.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Je suis marié
programme.desc: Un pavillon de banlieue. Une Porsche. Des bigoudis. Une cacahuète...

programme.title: Belle gueule
programme.desc: C'est l'été, le sud. Tous les jours, Sarah, seize ans, vend des beignets sur les plages avec son père. Un soir, elle fait la rencontre de Baptiste...

programme.title: Héros
programme.desc: Maxime a 14 ans. Il vit dans un petit village. Adolescent à la carrure ingrate, il peine à trouver grâce aux yeux d'Astrid, la jeune fille de 15 ans dont il est amoureux. Un matin, le village se réveille avec un immense graffiti sur le mur de l'école primaire. Si l'on ignore qui en est l'auteur, on sait tout de même quelle en est la cause : le maire sortant, unique candidat à sa succession, a enrôlé dans sa liste un militant local du front national. Les autorités ouvrent l'enquête tandis que les jeunes cherchent à connaître l'identité de leur héros. maxime voit là une belle occasion d'attirer l'attention d'Astrid.

programme.title: Tout le monde dit je t'aime
programme.desc: Marion quatorze ans, vient de recevoir un mot d'amour de son copain. Elle demande l'avis de sa meilleure amie, Joséphine. Les deux jeunes filles ne sont pas d'accord quant à l'interprétation du mot “Je t‘aime”.

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Nocturnes
programme.desc: Tes est en train de sortir de l'anorexie. La remontée à la surface est difficile, le corps est déréglé, ne répond plus de la même manière. Remanger, c'est accepter de lâcher prise, de perdre le contrôle. C'est à la fois reprendre des forces et accepter sa vulnérabilité. Mais le jeu en vaut la chandelle.

programme.title: Petit crabe
programme.desc: Jeanne vit au bord de la mer. Elle est jeune mais amère. Elle travaille à la poissonnerie parce qu'il faut bien...par dépit surement. Elvis à sa vie, son bateau. Ça lui suffit. De temps en temps, peut être plus maintenant que Kevin, son meilleur pote, est parti étudier à Lyon, il va voir Jeanne. Elle l'intrigue, le perturbe. Perturbe son monde...

programme.title: Les enfants de la nuit
programme.desc: Printemps 1944, dans un village reculé. Henriette, 20 ans, vit seule avec son grand-père Charles. Sa mère a rejoint le maquis. Henriette vit une histoire d'amour avec Josef, un jeune soldat allemand.

programme.title: Bourgeons
programme.desc: Chaque matin, c'est le rituel : Camille, une dame de quatre-vingts printemps sort de chez elle en trimbalant deux gros arrosoirs pour s'occuper de son jardin de l'autre côté de la rue.

programme.title: Petit astre
programme.desc: Alexis, 9 ans, va prendre le train tout seul pour la première fois. Au même moment, à des milliers de kilomètres, une sonde spatiale s'apprête à se réveiller.

programme.title: Rideau
programme.desc: Tom, comédien, vient de se faire quitter par son amie Angela, comédienne dans la même troupe que lui.Encore très amoureux, il tente de la reconquérir.

programme.title: Le Vent tourne
programme.desc: Un weekend d'été à la campagne. Une toute jeune fille s'éloigne de sa famille et se baigne nue dans la rivière. Elle pose ses vêtements sur une grosse pierre bienveillante. Lorsqu'elle ressort de l'eau, ils ont disparu.

programme.title: Les difficultés de la plaine
programme.desc: Marlène et Bachir travaillent en intérim dans un autodrome. Marlène a commis une petite faute dénoncée par un collègue, elle est mise à pied.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Fille du calvaire
programme.desc: Jérôme est tombé amoureux d'une jeune femme qu'il essaie de séduire. Jour après jour, il raconte l'évolution des opérations à son ami Patrick qui dispense ses conseils et vit par procuration les aventures de son cadet.

programme.title: Règlement de Conte
programme.desc: Mona et Hassan sont frère et soeur par alliance et ne s'entendent pas du tout. Ils sont envoyés dans un camp dirigé par le professeur de théâtre Melle Sankaré. Des les premières répétitions, une bagarre éclate entre eux. Punis, ils sont oubliés dans la foret. A leur réveil, ils ont changé de corps.

programme.title: Quelque chose brûle
programme.desc: Margot a des souvenirs, des idées noires qui la hantent et la mènent dans les montagnes de son enfance, chez son frère Adrien. Dans le froid de l'hiver le fantôme d'un frère disparu resurgit.

programme.title: La Plongeuse
programme.desc: Une plongeuse professionnelle s'entraîne intensément sous les coups de sifflets de son entraîneur. Epuisée, elle refuse de plonger une nouvelle fois et décide d'aller voir un masseur.

programme.title: De haute naissance
programme.desc: Le 12 juillet 1884, dans la demeure Modigliani, Garsin, un huissier et quatre policiers sont chargés de saisir tous les biens de la famille.

programme.title: Descente mortelle
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se fraie un chemin vers la Floride.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille sur une île où elles sont pourchassées.

programme.title: Tokyo Tribe
programme.desc: Dans un Tokyo futuriste, la ville est divisée en quartiers, dirigés par des gangs distincts. Mera, le chef de l'un d'eux, souhaite régler une affaire personnelle avec un membre d'une faction rivale, entraînant ainsi une guerre totale.

programme.title: High School U.s.a.
programme.desc: Dans une classe de terminale, J.J. poursuit la petite amie d'un rival d'une classe supérieure.

programme.title: Jeu Mortel
programme.desc: En quête de détente, le Dr Emilia Priestly se rend à Mystery Island, un complexe hôtelier immersif sur le thème du meurtre et du mystère. Dès le début du jeu, un drame survient : le fondateur reclus du complexe est assassiné.

programme.title: Vivre dans la crainte
programme.desc: Melissa, créatrice de mode à succès, réalise rapidement que son nouveau mari, Kevin, n'est pas le prince charmant qu'elle imaginait, mais un coureur de jupons sans ambition. Lorsqu'elle entame une procédure de divorce, elle découvre que Kevin a le droit de rester dans la maison qu'elle a payée jusqu'à ce que le divorce soit prononcé, et les deux deviennent des colocataires infernaux. Quand Kevin est retrouvé mort, tous les regards se tournent vers Melissa. Parviendra-t-elle, la principale suspecte, à prouver son innocence ?

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Un garçon de onze ans très perturbé, élève de l'American Boychoir School, fait la rencontre d'un chef de chœur qui va permettre à son talent d'éclore.

programme.title: Pets To The Rescue
programme.desc: Lorsque un frère et une sœur sont enlevés après avoir trouvé un camion d'or volé, ce sont leurs animaux de compagnie qui doivent prendre les choses en main pour les sauver !

programme.title: Stay
programme.desc: Un jeune homme dépressif annonce à son psychiatre qu'il va se suicider dans trois jours. Celui-ci va l'entraîner dans un voyage cauchemardesque entre la vie et la mort à travers la ville.

programme.title: Usurpation
programme.desc: Katie déménage en ville avec sa jeune fille pour démarrer une nouvelle vie. Elle devient rapidement amie avec un autre couple qui commence à se poser des questions après avoir observé son étrange comportement.

programme.title: Stratton
programme.desc: Stratton, agent du MI6, s'infiltre avec son coéquipier Marty dans un laboratoire iranien pour intercepter le vol de molécules chimiques mortelles. Mais à leur arrivée, celles-ci ont déjà disparu et la mission tourne mal…

programme.title: Les 3 crimes de West Memphis
programme.desc: En 1993, trois enfants sont retrouvés mort à West Memphis, ville de l'Arkansas. Accusés d'être des satanistes adorateurs de musique Heavy Metal, trois adolescents ont été condamnés l'année suivante à perpétuité pour ce triple meurtre.

programme.title: Pionniers malgré eux !
programme.desc: Ils sont venus pour l'or mais ils devront se contenter du plomb de leur tuyauterie.

programme.title: La talentueuse Mademoiselle Cooper
programme.desc: Un prince, et héritier du trône, se trouve dans une impasse suite à une soirée qui a mal tourné. La famille royale fait donc appel à une excellente responsable en communication pour redorer son image ternie. Alors que la consultante se rend chez le prince, elle tombe malade et demande à son assistante d'y aller à sa place. Cette dernière – à l'insu de sa patronne- excelle dans la création de campagne de relations publiques du prince. Mais quand l'assistante tombe amoureuse de lui et que ses sentiments sont réciproques, elle doit lui révéler la vérité et voir ce qui arrivera quand il saura.

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Un directeur de publicité à succès acquiert la capacité d'entendre les pensées des femmes et utilise cela à son avantage pour progresser au travail et gagner le cœur de son nouveau patron.

programme.title: Our Idiot Brother
programme.desc: Ned (Paul Rudd) est bien intentionné, mais le bon sens lui fait défaut. Alors quand il débarque dans la vie de ses trois sœurs (Emily Mortimer, Elizabeth Banks, et Zooey Deschanel), les rires sont garantis.

programme.title: John Grishams The Rainmaker (1997)
programme.desc: Matt Damon joue Rudy Baylor, un avocat débutant dans un dossier très médiatisé, face à une armée de requins. Il a de son côté Deck Shifflet, un " parajuriste" fougueux dont la spécialité est d'échouer à l'examen du barreau.

programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: Un militaire de renom retourne sur les terres ou il a connu les plus grands succes de sa carriere. Alors qu'il renoue des liens avec un amour de jeunesse, il tombe contre toute attente sous le charme d'une militaire de l'Air Force qu'on lui a assigné.

programme.title: Secousse Sismique
programme.desc: Charley Baxter découvre qu'un tremblement de terre géant va annihiler le nord de l'Atlantique. Il doit désormais travailler avec le Dr Amy Lane, sismologue, afin d'arrêter le gouffre qui menace de couper l'Amérique et le reste du monde en deux.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: Good Advice
programme.desc: Ryan Turner est un jeune banquier-investisseur qui connaît un succès incomparable. Ryan court beaucoup trop les jupons et couche régulièrement avec ses clientes, y compris, malheureusement pour lui, Veronica Simpson, la femme de son plus important client, Donald Simpson.

programme.title: Very Good Girls
programme.desc: Lors de leur premier été après la fin du lycée, deux adolescentes new-yorkaises se promettent de perdre leur virginité. Lorsqu'elles tombent toutes les deux amoureuses du même artiste de street art, l'amitié des deux jeunes filles est mise à rude épreuve pour la première fois.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: Lucky girl
programme.desc: Ashley est la femme la plus chanceuse de New York. Mais sa chance s'intervertit bizarrement avec celle du jeune homme le plus malchanceux de la ville.

programme.title: À Ceux qui Nous Ont Offensés
programme.desc: Vivants en parias à la périphérie du Gloucestershire, trois générations de Cutler, la célèbre famille de criminels professionnels, passent leur temps à planifier leur prochain casse et à se moquer de la police. Mais de plus en plus, Chad, l'aîné, qui est sous la coupe de Colby, le patriarche de la famille et maître des opérations, se retrouve tiraillé entre son désir de mener une vie tranquille avec sa femme et son fils, loin du crime, et le respect mêlé de crainte qu'il éprouve pour son père. Lorsque Colby élabore un plan visant une collection d'art privée, une vie entière de mauvaises décisions, de violence insensée et de criminalité commence à s'effondrer, soulignant le fait que Chad, digne fils et héritier de son père, doit faire un choix. Chad trouvera-t-il le courage de s'affirmer et de prendre son envol, ou détruira-t-il la famille ? Après tout, il n'en a qu'une.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

Mais Alex ne revoit Isabel que trois mois après, quand elle lui apprend qu'elle est enceinte. Sur un coup de tête, il la demande en mariage. Mais Alex et Isabel découvrent très vite qu'un mariage ne se résume pas qu'à une chapelle à Las Vegas et un imitateur d'Elvis.

programme.title: Hitch

programme.title: Big movie

programme.title: Jet Lag

programme.title: La dernière balle à pile ou face

L'armée américaine a pris le contrôle du laboratoire sur ordre de la sécurité nationale et, peu après, a mis en place des mesures visant à militariser l'entité. Les détails des événements inexplicables qui s'y sont produits sont rendus publics après être restés classifiés pendant près de quarante ans.

programme.title: Feast 2

programme.title: Transylvanie

Pour une plongée dans l'horreur, aussi.

programme.title: Intro Dominique
programme.desc: Intro Dominique

Son ennemi juré, Octopus, a un but bien différent : dans sa folle quête d'immortalité, il s'apprête à détruire la ville. Aux quatre coins de la cité, le Spirit traque le tueur. Sur son chemin, le héros masqué croise des femmes, toutes sublimes, qui cherchent à le séduire, l'aimer ou le tuer... Seul son amour de toujours ne le trahira pas : Central City, la ville qui l'a vu naître... deux fois.

programme.title: Monster Hunter

Au cours d'une tentative désespérée pour rentrer chez elle, l'intrépide lieutenant rencontre un chasseur mystérieux (Tony Jaa), qui a survécu dans ce monde hostile grâce à ses aptitudes uniques. Faisant face à de terrifiantes et incessantes attaques de monstres, ces guerriers vont devoir faire équipe pour se défendre et espérer trouver un moyen de retourner dans notre monde.

programme.title: Perrie Edwards On The Cost Of Fame
programme.desc: A panic attack can feel like you're dying from a heart attack this is something former Little Mix member Perrie Edwards has experienced numerous times over the last few years. Perrie talks about how her anxiety feels like her adult is 'going offline', leaving the child in her crying for help.

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Masked Bandits

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E01

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E04
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: For many people, Sardinia is THE Mediterranean dream island: clichés like crystal-clear water and picturesque coastlines are reality here. Wild horses inhabit the vast unpopulated plateaux of Gesturi. In the adjacent high regions lies the kingdom of the imposing Mouflon. The curved horns of the male come in handy when battling over the females during rutting season. A breathtaking underwater world is hidden beneath the crystal clear water surrounding the island. Colourful fish, corals and sea snails live down here - as well as the basking shark! He can grow up to ten metres long, but he's completely harmless: with his huge mouth he only fishes microorganisms from the water. Sicily, off the coast at the tip of Italy's ‘boot', is the largest island in the Mediterranean. The island's most famous landmark is already visible from far-off: Etna, at 3340 metres the highest active volcano in Europe. Only 40 kilometres away another volcano looms high: Stromboli, which lies in the middle of the sea. It spews lava and fire at virtually minute intervals. From ancient times on, humans have feared the volcanoes of south Italy. Even today, there are 2500 year-old temple grounds still standing on Sicily. These days nature is re-claiming the age-old buildings – Mason bees and lizards inhabit the cracks and crevices, while lush flower meadows surround the ancient pillars. Abruzzo, lying level with Rome, is the wild heart of southern Italy. The rugged, uninhabited mountain world with its unspoilt beech forests make Abruzzo something special: this is Italy from its unfamiliar side! The inaccessible slopes are the territory of the extremely rare Apennine chamois. During rutting, the bucks engage in breakneck chases among the rocks.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?
programme.desc: Italy is a vacationer's paradise. The food, the people, the sights and sounds, the history! But are the tourists doing it right when it comes to the trying out authentic food in Rome? Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. With the help of her food journalist buddy, Saverio de Luca, Liesel sifts through pasticceri, food festivals, touristed hotspots, all in an effort to understand real Roman food.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Emlia Romagna: What's the food like?
programme.desc: The region of Emilia Romagna is lush with gentle rolling hills where time honored ingredients like truffles, olives, and vast vineyards can be found. But this region is usually overshadowed by it's more famous neighboring cities, Florence and Venice. To understand the food of this region, Liesel explores the quaint sea-side town of Rimini and the hugely impressive Bologna. It's a tale of discovering local foodie passion that allows Liesel to hunt for truffles and try her hand in making her own gelato, a the world's only Gelato University!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?
programme.desc: In the land of tequila, Liesel gets the skinny on the premium export of Jalisco, blue agave tequila. From harvesting agave with the legendary jimadores, to understanding the process of distillation, Liesel is on the hunt to appreciate and understand the production requirements of this spirit that makes it what it is. Are they worth it only if they're from Jalisco or can they be made somewhere else for cheaper and better..? Liesel finds out!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26
programme.desc: As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. When pigments needed for overglaze painting run short, Mun Saseung turns to Hwa-ryeong for supplies—drawing Gangcheon straight to her. Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter ARO! ARO burst into the music scene in July 2018 with the single A Good Daughter. Her stage name means engraving in Korean which conveys her hope to engrave her name in the minds of the public. She's also known for her ability to express common relatable issues in her own unique way deeply touching and soothing listeners' hearts. Sentimental at times yet unpredictable at others she's definitely engraving her name in our hearts. In this episode ARO performs SEESAW When The Night Comes Day 1 Why Did You Answer? and also her cover of Delispice's Confession. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: UMEED INDIA
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES

Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.desc: Nel futuro l'umanità vive in città protette da cupole sulla superficie di Marte.
